independent_domain_result.scope: Exact fixed finite input census and matrix witnesses; no promotion of the old arithmetic census lemma into a real-polytope completeness proof.

remaining_obligations: Formalize the linear-basis characterization and the completeness bridge from exhaustive rational bases to all extreme points of the real frame polytope.
The kernel checks the integer list and its actual frame/tomography/negative equations; general real-matrix PSD and spectral transport remain separate formal obligations.
General frame-polytope subtype operad identities, composition coherence, symmetric actions and quotient presentation are not instantiated.
The original 2+72+72=146 source lemma is an arithmetic/incidence fact; it is not reused as a vertex enumeration proof.

claim_boundary.supports: A complete finite native basis census on the fixed 18-ray input, exact real-symmetric rational tomography, strict/semidefinite shifted-matrix bounds and explicit negative quadratic witnesses. Kernel checks are on the actual listed integer certificates.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: A formal Lean theorem identifying the entire real polytope vertex set, a general real spectral/PSD transport theorem, or positivity from finite frame additivity.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: Independently exhaustive exact basis computations and every actual finite matrix witness, with a separate literal integer-list kernel certificate; the general real-polytope completeness bridge remains open.
claim_boundary.next_test: Review basis coverage, source geometry, generated-data translation and the exact strict/non-strict spectral tests before promoting any broader claim.

review_regressions: Ten shared audit regression tests passed normally and under Python -O; each test may exercise all ten tasks.

final_native_integration.scope: Fresh current source tree, distinct from historical per-attempt snapshots. Local exact gates, no whole-repository/hosted-CI claim.

researcher: One local Codex researcher. Independent domain predicates are separate code, not an independent author or panel.
